_comment: n2cms registers these via [ExpressionPrefix] in src/Framework/N2/Web/Compilation. Each builder declares the C# it compiles to in its own ExpressionFormat property; these are those strings, with {0} written as {value}. The static methods they call are ported with the rest of N2, so nothing new has to be implemented.

CodeExpressionBuilder returns new CodeSnippetExpression(entry.Expression) - the value IS the C# to emit, so the template is the bare placeholder. Registering this used to be impossible because the converter escaped {value} unconditionally, which turned '<%$ Code: "AutoZone2" %>' into @(\"AutoZone2\"). The escape now follows the template: a placeholder inside a string literal is data, one outside it is code.
